digest.component_or_area: CLI argument parsing and advanced command handlers
propositions: Advanced command grammars (bridge, reconcile, audit, verify, workflow, identity) currently mix inline argparse construction with manual dispatch and unsafe top-level help forms
Argparse factories must be reusable, lean (no Pydantic AI, FastAPI, Jira transport, workflow executor imports), and side-effect-free per S2a contract
ParseError exceptions raised by migrated RebarArgumentParser must be caught and converted to identical exit code 2 with unchanged stderr/usage bytes
Parser factories must support optional keyword passthrough (usage, add_help, formatter_class) to preserve bespoke presentation for verify, remote-cert, and trusted-env commands
Every advanced route must have a valid registered factory reference and successfully construct a parser without executing handlers or importing optional runtimes
